status.description: People stages to include. Empty means any stage.

tagIds.description: Require all these tags. Resolve tag names with people.tags first.

anyOf.description: Inclusive calendar-day filter. Relative periods use the church timezone. Today excludes overdue dates. Weeks start Monday. Null means no date filter.

search.description: Task title or description search, not a date or status filter.

assignedToId.description: Exact account id from assignee lookup. Use view my_tasks for the current user; use all with this id for another assignee.
